BehaviorTree._description: Drive the lunar rover with the Base tab while slam_toolbox builds a map, then confirm to save it.

Action.message: slam_toolbox is not running. Set slam to true under hardware.robot_description.urdf_params in config.yaml, rebuild lunar_sim, and restart the Runtime.

Action.prompt: Build Map uses the front lidar. Drive carefully: Base teleoperation does not check for collisions. Select Start, switch to Teleoperation, and use the Base tab. Stop moving before returning to Objectives and pressing Continue to save. Abort discards this save; slam_toolbox keeps mapping until the Runtime is restarted with slam off.

SubTree.user_interaction_prompt: Drive with the Base tab to explore the lunar surface. Stop moving, return to Objectives, and press Continue to save the map, or Abort to skip saving. Mapping stays on after this Objective ends.

SubTree.input_port: Map filename prefix, without an extension. Relative paths use slam_toolbox's working directory. Existing files with this prefix may be overwritten.
